prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production RGBA sprite atlas for modular mythic equipment in Arcana Arena, Godot game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE: the existing small bearded wizard sprite sheet. Match its hand-painted fantasy game rendering, heavy dark outlines, chunky shapes, warm metallic highlights and readable small-scale details. Do not reproduce the character.

Create ONE transparent atlas, portrait 1024x1536, exactly FOUR columns and SIX rows of equal 256x256 square cells. No borders, grid marks, labels or text. Exactly one isolated equipment part per cell, centered with at least 24 pixels of transparent padding. All parts use the SAME set design: dark violet steel, antique gold filigree and bright diamond-shaped lilac crystals, a mythic royal archmage style. Crisp substantial painted material, restrained crystal glow, no detached sparkles.
COLUMNS in every row, left to right: FRONT view, LEFT-facing profile, BACK view, RIGHT-facing profile. Views are the same object, never another design.

ROW 1: low ornate crystal circlet that wraps around the band of a wizard's pointed hat, with three upward crystalline spikes and gold rim. This is an attachment, NOT an entire hat. It must sit above eyes and not cover a face.
ROW 2: short engraved armored chest mantle/breastplate for a tiny stout wizard, shoulder caps connected to a chest plate, open scooped neck, tapered waist, no arms, no fabric robe, no body, no head, no gloves.
ROW 3: a SINGLE armored wizard boot, broad rounded toe, violet dark leather covered in gold engraved greave, one diamond crystal on its shin. SINGLE boot per cell, not a pair. Back shows heel.
ROW 4: an ornate floating crystal staff CROWN / finial, enclosing a large luminous lilac crystal in curved golden prongs. No long pole, no hands. Compact vertical object fitting around an existing staff tip.
ROW 5: a small golden signet ring with an amber gemstone, the band visible, chunky readable design.
ROW 6: a small magical silver-and-violet ring with an amethyst gemstone, the band visible, chunky readable design.

Actual transparent background and alpha between all parts. No people, no shadows below items, no environment. Every item must be inside its own cell. The anatomy and body in the reference must NOT appear in the output. Flat front/back and profiles suitable as 2D sprite overlays, not a presentation scene.
